_label: F2/M27+M28 pin: a legacy-REST-shaped 'guard' entry using lowercase status/conclusion values ('completed'/'success'), as GitHub's REST commit-status API can emit, WITHOUT a StatusContext ('state') field -- this is a defensive shape, not observed on this repo's PRs, but the contract is explicitly exact-case: only the literal strings 'COMPLETED'/'SUCCESS' pass. Without this fixture, 'conclusion != "SUCCESS"' -> 'str(conclusion).upper() != "SUCCESS"' (and the same status mutation) is undetectable, because every other CheckRun fixture already uses uppercase GraphQL-shaped values. The shipped script must reject this shape (exit 2) precisely because it is lowercase, not because anything else about it is wrong.
